collectie_herkomst: Archief van de Familie Van Daele-Nuytens, Gent, Belgie

provenance.geschiedenis: Acquired in 1780 through marriage to Baron Jan Pieter van Beersdijk
Bequeathed to her daughter, Prinses Anna van Beersdijk, in 1835
Passed down to her son, Graaf Floris van Wijck, upon her death in 1870
